fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the DCMS serve as the foundation of planetary defense, providing the manpower essential to territorial control while freeing BattleMech and armored assets for offensive operations. Motorized infantry travel on light unarmored vehicles that allow them to cover ground faster than the foot platoons that make up the bulk of DCMS garrison forces. District regulars rely on motorized platoons for security patrols across large garrison zones, forward observation, and the rapid response that foot troops cannot provide when trouble arises between widely separated posts. Armed with standard assault rifles, the cheapest and most widely manufactured personal weapon in the Inner Sphere. Effective range is limited, but any world with basic industry can produce and stockpile them in quantity, and resupply is rarely a concern even on remote garrison posts. These anti-aircraft specialists carry weapons configured to engage low-flying VTOLs, conventional aircraft, and aerospace fighters. Positioned around key installations or march columns, they provide point air defense that forces enemy pilots to think twice about low-altitude attack runs.
